verdict.rationale: Windmill's AI generation docs say an AI can edit workspace items and then open the Compare & Deploy page with those changes preselected. This implies prompt-driven editing, but the evidence never explicitly says flows can be generated or edited from a natural-language prompt. AI Agent steps and the MCP server are about running AI inside flows or triggering flows, not authoring them. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of prompt-to-flow generation, detail on which item types (flows vs scripts) the AI can create or edit, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
